full_page.content:
c. 1947
The following is a faithful transcription of a message written by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.P.M. Cap.
( on Seraphic Mass Association cards)
"God bless you Catherine. Keep us courage ... and kiss the cross just as Jesus offers it to us. He knows best. He can cure us too."
(A note in the handwriting of Father Solanus Casey on card in possession of: ) Mrs. Francis Leonard 25584 Koontz Roseville, MI. 48066
Another Message:
" Mr. and Mrs. S.J.Barnum - God's holy grace and guidance - patience in all trials." Emergenct membership God bless you Mrs. Barnum. We will pray for you and yours. July 20, 1947 Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
